title: Early to admit but this app is great so far
body:
I’m trying to manage a lot of new adjustments in my life and this app really helps sets a great tone for me. 
My mindset feels supported with the awesome tools they’ve set up on here and it’s worth it to strike a balance without having to sort out everything first, because with this app, they have a category for every daily/weekly/monthly duty there is, which you’d normally spend some time to figure out categories or even come up with categories on where to group your duties on your own. This can become discouraging and tiring to organise everything into its place, but this app clears all that for you, making you feel at ease knowing there’s a structure to follow. 

Get the app, it’s worth it. ✔️💯

body:
The app seems nice, I love the aesthetics 🫶🏾. However it would be awesome if there was an option to integrate your routine, tasks etc into your Google calendar or at least phone calendar to make the app more optimal and more useful🤔.

I’m not necessarily someone who likes using different apps that can perform somewhat of the same function, I like having things in one place without losing track of data and knowing that whatever update I do on the app will also reflect on my other calendars. This feature would be helpful ❤️
